description: Paper market maker on Polymarket BTC/ETH Up/Down markets. Instead of paying taker fees, it posts buy orders (bids) on both Up and Down, priced so both together cost less than $1. If both fill, the difference is locked-in profit whatever happens; makers also earn a share of taker fees as rebates. The risk is adverse selection: often only one side fills, usually the side that is about to lose. Fills are simulated from Polymarket's public trade tape with queue position respected. Forward test only: no historical order-book data exists to backtest honestly.

quoting.price_rule: join the best bid on each side; if the two best bids add up to 97c or less, improve each by 1c (never at or above the best ask)
quoting.inventory_rule: if this market already has unmatched shares on one side, quote only the other side (to complete the pair)

fills.rule: a bid on outcome O at price p fills from taker SELLs of O at <= p and taker BUYs of the other outcome at >= 1-p (the same trade seen from the complementary side), after the shares already queued at p when the order was placed; any trade through the level (better price) fills the whole order
fills.fill_price: the order's own limit price (makers pay no fee)

rebates.note: estimate: 20% of the taker fee on shares traded against our orders (Polymarket's crypto maker-rebate programme redistributes fees pro rata; the actual share can differ)

sizing.note: the same number of shares is bid on Up and Down, costing about 10% of equity per pair (a pair pays exactly $1 at settlement); when only one side has filled, the next quote is only for the missing side, up to the unmatched share count

risk.note: checked every run; a halt cancels quoting (open positions still settle)
